dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Huh, so you weren't paying attention last time, then?

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Basically, Sumeru Akademiya commissioned the Adventurers' Guild to investigate on their behalf, and we found an Irminsul Fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Judging by the scholars' response, it seemed to be an object of major significance for their research.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, there was an incident while we were transporting the Irminsul Fruit, and it blew up. That's the long and short of it.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Hosseini hasn't stopped moaning and groaning about it ever since. It's giving me a real headache...
